summary: Enhance your finance skills with our Internal Controls and Risk Assessment training. Learn to identify risks and implement effective controls for success.
lede: Internal Controls and Risk Assessment in Finance equips professionals to identify vulnerabilities, design safeguards, and monitor controls that protect organizational assets and support accurate financial reporting. The course develops practical capabilities in risk identification, control design, segregation of duties, continuous monitoring, and transparent reporting. You will apply the Three Lines of Defense model, use the COSO framework to evaluate control effectiveness, and map financial processes to uncover gaps. You will also build risk heat maps and segregation of duties matrices, design remediation plans for procurement and payroll, and test controls using evidence to support reliable assurance for leadership.
audienceIntro: This training is essential for professionals responsible for the integrity of financial systems and the mitigation of operational risks within the finance function.
modules: Foundations of Internal Control and Governance
Financial Process Controls and Fraud Prevention
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting processes. At least two years of experience in a finance, audit, or compliance role is recommended. No prior knowledge of specific risk management software is required, but familiarity with Microsoft Excel for data analysis is beneficial.
